reconstructed_captions.12: A man carves a notch into a wooden handle using a sharp piece of stone.
reconstructed_captions.13: He carefully fits the stone axe head into the notch of the wooden handle.
reconstructed_captions.14: The man begins to wrap natural cordage tightly around the axe head and handle.
reconstructed_captions.15: He pulls the cordage taut to securely fasten the stone head to the handle.
reconstructed_captions.16: He continues to wrap the cordage, building up a strong binding.
reconstructed_captions.17: The man ties off the cordage, completing the assembly of the stone axe.
reconstructed_captions.18: He holds the finished stone axe, inspecting the secure joint between head and handle.
reconstructed_captions.19: The man approaches a tree in the forest, ready to use the axe.
reconstructed_captions.20: He takes a firm stance and prepares to swing the axe at the tree trunk.
reconstructed_captions.21: He raises the stone axe high over his shoulder for the first strike.
reconstructed_captions.22: He swings the axe forcefully, striking the base of the tree.
reconstructed_captions.23: Wood chips fly from the tree trunk on the first impact.
reconstructed_captions.24: He pulls the axe back and takes another powerful swing at the tree.
reconstructed_captions.25: He strikes the same spot again, deepening the cut into the wood.
reconstructed_captions.26: The man continues to chop rhythmically into the base of the tree.
reconstructed_captions.27: A close-up shows the stone axe head biting deeper into the tree trunk.
reconstructed_captions.28: He continues chopping the tree, making steady progress on the cut.
reconstructed_captions.29: More wood chips fly as he continues to swing the axe into the deepening notch.
